generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Rimac Nevera hypercar (EPA make "Bugatti Rimac"): 120 kWh gross pack (usable 106.8-120 kWh depending on source), up to 500 kW DC (333 kW seen on an Ionity test), 22 kW AC. The Nevera R (MY2025+) is listed with a different 108/104 kWh pack by one database (not confirmed), so it may need its own powertrain as a variant. EPA MY2024-2026. Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/559860/rimac-nevera-ionity-charger-333kw/ ; https://evspecs.org/compare/rimac_nevera_1408-kw,rimac_nevera_r
